heading: ### What stays open — named, never closed by prose

findings.class: stale pointer presented live in the named home (same [U], anchor not re-resolved by this round's fix pass)
findings.skill_statement: The section sends the reader to `service-limits.md` §5 as the home of the driver-invocation unknown, and that §5 U1 carries the twin of the SKILL-side anchor wave 1 had fixed: corpus/knowledge/service-limits.md:220-223 (blob fc241f38e5392fbe7902c6e5fbc8b023d240ee43, identical at C* a41195df and C**) reads 'Whether any fleet driver would apply this table (or the tick) with no lane acting is the cadence's open [U] (`SKILL.md:1017-1019`)'. At C** SKILL.md:1017-1019 is the round-7 gap quotation and the sentence 'Round 8 closes it by measurement: **the cadence is a pin read executed at the' — no `[U]` token and no driver sentence; the `[U]` the citation names sits at SKILL.md:1023-1024 ('the round boundary; whether any fleet driver would ever invoke the command with' / 'no lane acting stays [U].'). The anchor was exact when written (b8eb96e round 9: [U] ends at 1019) and still exact at round 52 (7ff81a5: ends at 1019); round 53's own insertions moved it (+2 at C*, +3 more at C**), the same drift the wave-1 fix converted to a heading anchor inside SKILL.md without touching the corpus-side twin. Recommendation: heading-anchor the §5 U1 citation the way the section's own bullet was fixed.

findings.class: imprecise locator (heading anchor resolves; the sub-locator points to the wrong end of the named section)
findings.skill_statement: The heading anchor 'the re-sweep cadence section' resolves uniquely to `## The re-sweep cadence and the six-case confidence statement (round 8, measured)` at C** line 1015, and the round-8 [U] is there — but not at the section's closing note: within the section's span (1015-1160) the only `[U]` occurrence is line 1024, the last line of the section's LEAD paragraph ('daemon, no timer: "standing" is the ledger + the policy + an executed command at / the round boundary; whether any fleet driver would ever invoke the command with / no lane acting stays [U].'). The section's closing content carries no `[U]`: 1157-1158 read '- **Unknown in all six:** coordinated rewrites; cross-host stability; the 50 % / crossover; the two round-8 notes' own unknowns.' and the final bullet 1160 is '- **Read the method, not the rate** — at six cases the constant remains the / survivor taxonomy and the composition rule, not the headline percentage.' A reader following 'closing note' scans the bottom of a 146-line section and finds none. The fix removed the broken `:1017-1019` (verified) but replaced it with a locator that names the wrong position; 'lead paragraph' / 'opening note' (or the bare section name) is the accurate locator. The word 'unchanged' does hold: `git log -S'no lane acting stays' -- SKILL.md` returns only the round-8 commit c611d5d, so the sentence has not been edited since it was written.
